text:
maria: Heads-up: webinar 7 Apr. Need final social schedule for X + LI, hero assets (landscape + square), two benchmark hooks, and SDR routing plan.

sam: I'll write 2 benchmark narratives (cost/latency vs reliability) + 3 X thread openers by EOD.

jess: Creative can deliver hero_land.jpg, hero_sq.jpg, and a 3-frame GIF illustrating fallback routing. ETA Mon afternoon.

leo: Routing note: all promo links must include UTMs. Proposed: utm_medium=x_social, utm_campaign=webinar_apr7, utm_content={variant}. SDR queue = social_webinar.

sdr-triage: Confirmed. We'll auto-tag and escalate leads with >1 engagement to SDR. Provide sample intake fields.

maria: A/B messaging plan: A = "Lower inference cost, faster responses"; B = "Reliable inference at scale (fallbacks, SLAs)". Keep copy punchy for X.

sam: Draft short opens:
- A: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses. Webinar Apr 7 -> [link]"
- B: "Avoid inference downtime. Hear how Apr 7 -> [link]"
And a longer LI blurb for each.

jess: If creative delays, fallback = text-only + screenshot. Please include fallback copy in scheduler.

leo: Schedule proposal:
- Apr 1 09:00 PT: Teaser (X + LI)
- Apr 3 11:00 PT: Thread deep-dive (X org account)
- Apr 6 10:00 PT: Reminder (X + LI)
- Apr 7 09:00 PT & 12:00 PT: Live-day pushes (X)
Ensure timezone metadata in the scheduler.

maria: Ops ask: can we add marketing pixel to reg page? @ops-bot please ping frontend.

ops-bot: @frontend-team Please add marketing pixel flag to webinar reg page. Ticket WEB-3421 created.

sam: Post-webinar: we'll run a highlight thread + on-demand link and 2 DM templates for commenters/RTs.

jess: I'll upload assets to Drive + Figma and post links here when ready.

leo: I'll validate UTM ingestion in CRM Wed and confirm webhook mappings.

maria: Deliverables checklist: 1) hero assets, 2) hooks A/B final, 3) scheduler entries with UTMs, 4) SDR intake snippets, 5) DM templates. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

sam: ✅

jess: ✅ (upload to follow)

leo: ✅ (will confirm webhook)

sdr-triage: SDR snippets by Wed.

maria: I'll assemble the launch playbook and ask growth for a small amplification budget. :rocket:
